description: Create a new blog publication (the container that articles live under). Returns a publicationId needed for generate_blog_post. Optional languageCode sets this publication's language, as a BCP-47 code — one of: en, es, pt-BR, de, fr, cs. Omit to default to the brand's configured content language. If supplied, it must already be enabled on the brand's language roster (check with get_brand_languages, enable with add_brand_language first) — an un-enabled code is rejected with a 403.

articlePattern.description: Article path pattern; tokens {slug} (required), {category}, {lang}. E.g. '/blog/{category}/{slug}/'. Trailing slash follows the pattern. Default '{pathPrefix}/{slug}'. null clears.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

categoryPattern.description: Category hub path pattern with {category}, e.g. '/blog/{category}/'. Must not be able to match the same URL as articlePattern. Default derived from articlePattern. null clears.

hostingMode.description: 'postking' (default), 'self_hosted' (you render the blog with your own app against /api/blog-posts?blogId=<publicationId>) or 'external' (your own site serves it; PostKing only emits URLs from siteBaseUrl + patterns, no domain may be connected). Can be changed later with set_publication_hosting_mode.

languageCode.description: Language for this new publication, as a BCP-47 code. One of: en, es, pt-BR, de, fr, cs. Omit to default to the brand's configured content language. Must already be enabled on the brand's language roster (get_brand_languages / add_brand_language) — an un-enabled code returns 403.

siteBaseUrl.description: https origin (optional path) the publication's public URLs are built on, e.g. https://linkmatch.com. Overrides the connected-domain base and is honoured with no domain for hostingMode 'external'. null clears.

trailingSlash.description: Convenience toggle: true makes article and category URLs end with "/", false removes it (default off, slashless). Rewrites the stored articlePattern (and categoryPattern when set); with no articlePattern, true materializes '{pathPrefix}/{slug}/'. Combine with articlePattern to set both at once.

uncategorizedSegment.description: Path segment substituted for {category} on articles with no category. Default 'uncategorized'. null clears.

name: create_publication
